problems.quote: Manager explicitly understands no words in the plea; source paragraph22 corrects earlier expectation
problems.evidence: "Did you understand even a single word?" the manager asked the parents, "Is he playing the fool with us?" ... "That was an animal's voice," said the manager
problems.explanation: The manager only asks the parents whether they understood and calls the voice an animal's; he never explicitly says he understood no words, so "explicitly" overstates what is an inference.

problems.quote: Paragraph19 cash accusation made before parents
problems.evidence: The Chief indicated to me earlier this very day a possible explanation for your neglect—it concerned the collection of cash entrusted to you a short while ago—but in truth I almost gave him my word of honor that this explanation could not be correct.
problems.explanation: The manager reports the Chief's suggested explanation and says he almost vouched it was wrong, so calling it an accusation he made before the parents overstates the text.

result.note: Almost all records are sketches, labelled guesses or inferences consistent with the text read so far; only two overstated wordings were found, and none states anything from later in the book.
